claim: These are ERA5 grid-cell estimates, not rain-gauge measurements. A dry run means consecutive days with under 1 mm of rain; it is not a drought index, and ERA5’s tendency to produce too many light-rain days may make dry runs appear shorter than observed.
reason: Source says values are ERA5 reanalysis not gauge measurements, dry spell is not a drought index, and ERA5 light-rain bias may underestimate dry-spell length; all stated.
